text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Important rainfalls in northern Tunisia over the weekend. Farmers welcomed them with joy and relief.
-Tunisia beats Egypt 1-0 in preliminaries for the soccer world cup at a match played in Tunis on Sunday. A great step toward qualifying. President Ben Ali congratulated the Tunisian team.
- Bravo for the Tunisian soccer team. But no qualification yet.
- The National Solidarity Fund distributes aid to the poorest families during the fasting month of Ramadan.
